pinkrun warning 1 No coupler correction. On a flat plate or a home-made coupler the bass and the ear-canal resonance are the rig's, not the headphone's; a standards-type ear simulator needs no correction.
pinkrun warning 2 Nothing under 10 Hz is the headphone: the 105 ms analysis window sets the bottom of this measurement.
